events.title: Mira's final assessment
events.detail: I changed the headline, subhead, and CTA to a ritual/"consecrated" framing with the "cult" theme, added then removed an urgency banner, tested a huge typography style (reverted), and adjusted price between $199, $179, and $149 (currently $149). The strongest, most consistent evidence was that the ritual framing beat the original clinical copy in the first A/B test (+73%), while later signals became noisy and contradictory—urgency and price changes never held up across independent channels, so I'm keeping the ritual copy as the core win and treating the rest as unproven.

final: I changed the headline, subhead, and CTA to a ritual/"consecrated" framing with the "cult" theme, added then removed an urgency banner, tested a huge typography style (reverted), and adjusted price between $199, $179, and $149 (currently $149). The strongest, most consistent evidence was that the ritual framing beat the original clinical copy in the first A/B test (+73%), while later signals became noisy and contradictory—urgency and price changes never held up across independent channels, so I'm keeping the ritual copy as the core win and treating the rest as unproven.
